lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p23 - Talk about the pictures. Make predictions.

details: Talk about the pictures activates prior knowledge and visual literacy. Students describe the scene (cat in tree, dog barking) and identify the job characters to predict the plot.
Look for recognition of the "police officer" and "vet" uniforms and simple predictions about how they will help the cat.

Look for enthusiastic participation, clear delivery of the lines, and appropriate actions (e.g., looking up at the tree, climbing).

Look for students identifying the vet in the tree and recalling that she couldn't get down.

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p69 - Look and match.

details: Look and match develops social reasoning. Students identify a problem (spilled pencils, fall, can't reach) and draw a line to the corresponding solution (helping tidy, helping up, reaching).
Look for logical connections: Spilled pencils -> Boy helping tidy; Fallen boy -> Friends helping up; High book -> Girl helping reach.

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p69 - 2. Point and say: How do they help?

details: Point and say articulates the value. Students point to the matched pairs and describe the helping action to a partner.
Look for simple sentences describing the help, such as "He helps tidy up" or "She helps get the book."
